candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to fail and gateway checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment service metrics/logs not admitted; the 503 origin within payment is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout failing with 502 because order returns 502 after payment returns 503 on /v1/authorizations; inventory reservations succeed. Gateway and order metrics corroborate 502s on /v1/checkout and /v1/orders. Payment-side evidence is missing, so the bounded candidate is payment-induced failure.
missing_evidence: Payment service metrics (request status, dependency operations) to confirm 503 origin
Payment service logs/traces to identify why authorizations fail
Order service traces to confirm payment failure propagates to 502
